plate_comment: Counts down sci_set_engine_speed_request_timeout_count; at 0 it clears sci_set_engine_speed_request and its key, ending the service tool's SCI command 0x19 'SET RPM' request (was governor_speedLimitFloor_decrement)

Blends the all-speed governor's 0 % / 100 % throttle reference speeds (e2m ASG_Minimum / ASG_Maximum, sets 1 and 2) into all_speed_governor_minimum_reference_speed / _maximum_reference_speed. The weight governor_tuning_set_blend_weight (0 = set 1, 128 = set 2) comes from drivetrain_ratio through the six-entry tables at ROM 0x5a9c4 / 0x5a9d2 (all 128 in this ROM), or from governor_tuning_set_default_blend_weight_cal (e2m 1387 +8 ASG_Droop_Flag_Trim 'select droop source') when governor_system_config_flags bit 0x08 is set. It runs only when the computed fuel demand is 0 and the final fueling is below the friction fuel plus a deadband, or at the high idle override reset (was cm848_blendGovernorTuningSets) | earlier note: Selects governor_tuning_set_blend_weight (0 = the governor_speed_error_*_working set, 128 = the _b set) from drivetrain_ratio through the six-entry tables at ROM 0x5a9c4 (ratio x 2048 breakpoints 1843 / 2458 / 3482 / 6144 / 10240 / 40960) and 0x5a9d2 (weights, all 128 in this ROM), or uses governor_tuning_set_default_blend_weight_cal when governor_system_config_flags mask 0x08 is set, then writes governor_speed_error_high / _low as the weighted blend of the two sets ((w x b + (128 - w) x working) >> 7). It runs only when its entry conditions hold (computed fuel demand below friction_fuel_adjustment_for_coolant_temperature plus a deadband, or the high idle override reset) (was cm848_calculateRpmLimitsFromProtection).
